recipe.visualDefinition: A central female subject leaning on a rustic wooden bar, framed by dark wood pillars and lit with a mix of warm ambient light and cool cyan neon accents. The bottom third features a heavy typographic block with high-contrast sans-serif and fluid script elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by vertical wooden architectural elements
Cyan neon glow reflecting on skin and bar surfaces
Heavy white block text anchored against a dark base
Contrast between rustic wood textures and modern neon lighting
coreInvariants: Three-tiered typographic hierarchy at the bottom
Direct eye contact from the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium shot from the waist up, leaning forward into the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white block lettering in the lower third acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down through the script text to the bold block letters, and finally to the spaced-out name at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Darker, cluttered bar background provides depth while keeping focus on the subject and foreground text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark wood browns and blacks providing a neutral, warm-to-dark base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for primary typography to ensure maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan/Electric Blue used in neon signs, lighting highlights, and secondary script text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the text area; high saturation in the cyan highlights against desaturated shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm reds or oranges in the lighting to maintain the cyan/wood contrast.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses ultra-bold, wide geometric sans-serif with tight kerning.
Secondary text uses a monolinear, connected casual script with a slight upward slant.
Tertiary text uses a medium-weight sans-serif with extreme letter spacing (tracking).
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard glyph forms used for maximum impact.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, rigid geometric sans and a fluid, organic script.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule or spacing to separate name from title

preserve: The ultra-bold weight of the main title
The cyan color of the script
The wide tracking of the bottom name
avoid: Distressed or 'grunge' textures on the letters

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and modern feel for the main title.
Offers a casual, monolinear script feel that matches the 'neon' aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A blonde woman in a black t-shirt leaning on a rustic wooden bar in a dimly lit tavern. The scene is framed by dark wooden beams. A cyan neon sign 'My Bar' is visible in the background, casting a blue glow on her hair and the bar surface. Bottles and a disco ball are visible in the background. The bottom third of the image should be dark/shadowed to accommodate text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of text at the bottom. Top level: a cyan script phrase slanted slightly. Middle level: a large, bold white geometric sans-serif title in all caps. Bottom level: a name in cyan sans-serif with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the cyan glow consistent across the neon sign and the subject?
Does the script text overlap the block text slightly?
Is the bottom name significantly more spaced out than the main title?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the cyan neon glow
Amount of clutter on the bar top
Degree of slant in the script typography
mustRedesign: Specific logos on cans or signs
Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: High-contrast legibility in the lower third
Balanced composition between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the white text is perfectly centered.
Ensure the cyan color matches between the text and the background neon.
Verify the wood grain texture is visible but not distracting.
Confirm the subject's pose feels integrated with the bar environment.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rustic, low-key interior photograph with a three-layer typographic footer using a mix of ultra-bold sans-serif and accent-colored script.
